verdict.tagline: Tactical shooter bogged down by technical and matchmaking hurdles.
for_you_if: you play in a coordinated squad
you tolerate a steep learning curve
not_for_you_if: you will not install third-party launchers
you lack patience for matching cheaters
you need reliable server hit registration

claims.claim: Reviewers report that hit registration issues and unreliable audio make it common to be shot through walls or struggle with inconsistent combat mechanics.

citations.review_text:
Jynxzi makes it look like Siege is playable.

Then you queue ranked and remember you’re just here to get pre-fired through a wall by a level 82 Smurf called “xXxASHMAINxXx” while your teammate is reinforcing a rotate in the middle of site.

Everyone in this game thinks they’re Beaulo, plays like they’re in Champs, and dies like they’ve never seen a staircase before. Gold players call you “braindead,” Emerald players say “team diff,” and the actual Champion on the enemy team is crouch-spamming in a pixel angle no human should ever find.

Half the deaths don’t even feel real. You drone, you clear, you clear again, and somehow there’s still a guy sitting in the one corner nobody ever checks. And your teammate instantly goes “why no drone?”

Chat is always the same too. “XIM,” “cheater,” “peekers advantage,” “hitreg trash,” like it’s never just someone outplaying you.

And every time you think it can’t get worse, Ubisoft drops a patch that somehow makes sound more confusing than it already was.

Still queue again though. No idea why.

Prime siege was a beautiful thing. In ubisoft fashion, they put this game in the dirt. I wish jynxi never revived this game because it is a game not worth reviving. I'd say 78% of your bullets dont register especially when it is a headshot. Only their head is showing and you hear the noise to signify you hit them? No. Popped a totem of undying. Half the time you are getting fired at through the wall based on noise alone. I've played games like Marvel Rivals and Valorant and they are MISERABLE. The only thing separating them from Siege is that everything in those games works as intended so you cant get too mad. Nothing in this game works as intended. Pure misery for no other reason than common ubisoft incompetence.
